title: FreeType 2.13.3 ported -- TTF text rendering for AmigaOS
body:
FreeType 2.13.3 is now available as a bundled amiport library (`lib/freetype/`). 486 KB static archive, 218 exported symbols, full FreeType 2 API minus zlib / environment-properties / SVG. This unlocks TrueType and OpenType text rendering for any SDL1 game or graphical port that wants real fonts.

The subset is SDL_ttf-shaped: base, truetype, sfnt, autofit, smooth, pshinter, psaux, psnames, raster. Paired with the Aminet SDL_ttf 2.0.9 and the toolchain's libSDL.a, the three archives link cleanly into a 772 KB binary -- proven end-to-end.

Built `-O0 -m68000` for safety on bebbo-gcc 6.5.0b, with per-file `-O1 -fno-strict-aliasing` promotions on five audited hot-path files: the AA rasterizer, the TrueType bytecode interpreter, the mono scanline rasterizer, and two bitmap helpers. Zero soft-float symbol pulls -- all arithmetic is 16.16 and 26.6 fixed-point integer, so downstream consumers stay clear of the `mathieeesingbas.library` crash family that hit amigit's diff engine.

26 unit tests pass on vamos covering library init, face open, glyph loading, rasterization (normal and bitmap content), kerning, outline transforms, 68k-specific bitmap alignment, and stress paths. The `make -C tests/freetype demo` target renders the letter 'A' at 20 px and dumps the AA bitmap as ASCII art -- permanent visual proof that the rasterizer produces recognizable glyphs, not just non-null buffers.

Consumers should set `__stack >= 65536`. The TrueType bytecode interpreter plus autofitter push deep call stacks on complex hinted fonts; combined with AmigaOS's 2-4 KB hidden dos.library depth, smaller stacks will Guru.

Next up: first Category 5 SDL game port using this stack (PDR-014). See the full [library roster](/shims.html#libs-heading) or browse [`lib/freetype/`](https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport/tree/main/lib/freetype) on GitHub.

title: Dropbear SSH client -- first SSH for classic AmigaOS
body:
dbclient from Dropbear 2025.89 is now available -- the first SSH client for AmigaOS 3.x. Connect to any modern SSH server with password or Ed25519 public key authentication.

Features: ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption, interactive terminal with arrow keys and tab completion, Ctrl-C forwarding, exit code propagation. Includes `dropbearkey` for on-Amiga key generation. 309 KB binary, 23 automated tests passing.

Requires a 68020+ CPU and a TCP/IP stack (Roadshow, AmiTCP, or Miami). Tested on FS-UAE A3000/030 -- not yet verified on real hardware.

**Known issue:** public key auth crashes on exit (AN_MemCorrupt). The SSH session itself works correctly -- the crash is only during cleanup. Password auth exits cleanly. Root cause investigation planned.

Grab it from [the packages page](/packages/?name=dropbear).

title: amigit 0.1 -- first git client for classic AmigaOS
body:
amigit is the first native git client for AmigaOS 3.x, built on a ported libgit2 1.8.5. It covers the essentials -- init, add, commit, status, log, show, diff, branch, tag, checkout, reset -- running entirely on real 68k hardware.

The port required porting zlib 1.3.1 and libgit2 to amiport first, plus an FS-UAE trap workaround for a mathieeesingbas issue in libgit2's patch generator. Writeup coming soon.

Grab it from [the packages page](/packages/?name=amigit).
